message.subject: Re: Supply enquiry
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.1% (sc:70190@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 3.2% (fc:310011@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

# Our liquidity and your call-offs

letter - 2026-10-19 - Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

a large customer from the heating industry has cancelled its orders for 2027, and our bank is watching our liquidity closely. We would be very grateful if you could pay our invoices within 10 days from November and confirm firm call-offs for the first quarter.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Pfaffenreuth GmbH
